message: Baga nagaan dhuftan! Ani Raajii dha. Mee waliin haa barannu, haa taphannu!
Akkam qaxale! Ati hojii gaarii hojjette. Urjii tokko argatte ⭐!
Baay'ee gaarii! Ati barataa cimaa dha. Itti fufi!
Wow! Deebii sirrii deebiste. Ani siif gammadeera!
Dogoggorri barnoota keessa waan jiruu dha. Irra deebi'ii yaali. Ati ni dandeessa!
Hin yaadda'in. Yeroo biraa ni milkoofta!
Har'a waan haaraa baratte. Barachuu keetiif galatoomi!
Mee qubee, jechaa fi lakkoofsa waliin haa barannu!
Ati guyyaa guyyaan fooyyeffachaa jirta. Itti fufi!
Ani Rajin si wajjinan jira. Mee haa qorannu!
